rationale: Amino acid catabolism dominates at this late stage; glucose exhausted. Propionate, maltose, arabinose provide secondary carbon. Fermentation yields acetate, butyrate, CO₂, H₂, and ammonia. Growth rate constrained by nutrient depletion and redox balance in anaerobiosis. Carbon audit: ~340 mmol C in (amino acids + secondary sources) minus ~262 mmol C for growth leaves ~78 mmol C for fermentation products (acetate, butyrate, CO₂ as CO₂ equivalents), which is consistent with fluxes shown.
